RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Thunderfire calamity
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Chain hits create at most one thunderfire field per second, with a 3.5-cell radius and a 4-second duration. Each second it deals 29.25 + 6.5 × chain level additional damage and applies burns to up to 16 enemies. Enemies dying with the wearer's burn release a 6-cell thunderburst, hitting up to 12 enemies for 65 + 13 × burn level damage. Thunderburst cooldown: 1 second.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Bloodforged covenant
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Actual healing refreshes a shield on the recipient equal to 97.5% of healing dealt, lasting 10 seconds. After absorbing 200 shield damage, heals up to 12 free colonists within 10 cells for 39 ordinary injury points each. Cooldown: 1 second. This healing does not retrigger these healing interactions.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Frozen kill zone
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Direct hits against frost-slowed or stunned enemies release a 4-cell frost blast at the target, dealing 117 + 48.75% of this hit's direct damage to up to 6 enemies. Cooldown: 3 seconds. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Soulblade dance
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Every third valid direct hit releases soulblades at up to 3 enemies within 8 cells of the target. Each deals 52 + 1.3 × soul marks + 19.5% of this hit's direct damage. Cooldown: 2 seconds. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Golden foundry
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Delivers 520 steel, 52 plasteel and 13 gold to the colony each day.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Bountiful workshop
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: All colonists gain 130% plant work speed and mining speed. Provides 13 medicine, 78 chemfuel and 26 fine meals each day.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Lord of thunder
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 2.6 chain levels. Every fourth valid direct hit calls lightning onto up to 10 enemies within 18 cells of the target, dealing 130 + 16.25 × chain level additional damage each. Cooldown: 3 seconds.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: World-burning sun
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 2.6 burn levels. Every fifth valid direct hit leaves a 6-cell Sunfire field at the target for 6 seconds. Each second it deals 52 + 13 × burn level additional damage and applies burns to up to 16 enemies. Cooldown: 5 seconds.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Undying blood emperor
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 65% direct lifesteal. Every 200 points of actual healing releases a blood tide if enemies are within 8 cells. Deals 130 + 16.25 × the wearer's health multiplier damage to up to 12 enemies and heals up to 12 free colonists within 10 cells for 65 ordinary injury points each. Cooldown: 3 seconds.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Earthbreaker
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 195% health. Every third valid direct hit shakes an 8-cell area around the target, dealing 65 + 39 × the wearer's health multiplier additional damage to up to 16 enemies. Cooldown: 3 seconds.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Everwinter throne
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: During combat, every 6 seconds freezes up to 16 enemies within 12 cells, applying frost slow and a 2-second stun. Targets already slowed or stunned take an additional 117 damage.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Convergence of blades
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 1.3 to melee and ranged cooldown divisors. Every fourth valid direct hit delivers up to five extra cuts to the original target, each dealing 52 + 26% of this hit's direct damage. Stops if the target can no longer fight. Cooldown: 2 seconds. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Star-piercing arbalest
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Every third valid direct hit against a target at least 12 cells away fires a piercing beam. It crosses the target and extends 18 cells behind it, about 4 cells wide, dealing 130 + 130% of this hit's direct damage to enemies struck. Cooldown: 3 seconds. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Crown of the dead
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 2.6 soul-harvesting levels and 3.9 additional soul marks per kill. Every fifth valid direct hit releases a soul tide at up to 8 enemies within 12 cells of the target, dealing 19.5 + 3.25 × soul marks additional damage each. Cooldown: 3 seconds. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Shelter of armies
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 0.65 to the damage-taken divisor. While an enemy is within 30 cells, every 6 seconds refreshes a 195-point shield on up to 12 free colonists within 12 cells, lasting 8 seconds.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Golden age
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each day grants 650 silver plus 3.25% of home stockpiles (combined silver payout capped at 13000), 26 gold and 130 shards. Shards are capped at 1000000.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Perpetual artisan
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: All colonists gain 260% work speed and research speed. Provides 7 components and 1 advanced components each day.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Ark of life
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: All colonists gain 195% plant harvest yield and 130% health. Each day provides 52 packaged survival meals and 13 medicine, and heals every free colonist for 104 ordinary injury points.
